messages.subject: Embedding carriage returns in strings
parts:
I am importing a file from csv, and one of the fields (VarName) is a
character string. I want to embed a carriage return into this string.
Simply putting "\n" into the CSV file
gives me a double backslash in the R data frame,:e.g:

csv:

Immediate Phlebotomy\\nType RBC+other 0.29 0.13 1.34 1.03 1.74

R-data:

36 Immediate Phlebotomy\\nType RBC+other 0.29 0.13 1.34 1.03 1.74

The relevance of this question for ggplot is that I want to use this as
the horizontal facet in a two-dimensional facet.

It remains to be seen if Hadley's remarkable imagination and coding has
anticipated a multi-line variable name for the facet title,

.... facet_grid (x, VarName)

but first I have to get the carriage return into the variable.

Suggestions?

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Embedding carriage returns in strings
parts:
Hi Rob,

It's probably easiest to do this after you have the data in R.
Assuming that the column you're interested in is a factor, inspect the
output of levels(df$myvar) and then modify accordingly. For example:

mtcars$cyl <- factor(mtcars$cyl)
levels(mtcars$cyl)
dput(levels(mtcars$cyl))

levels(mtcars$cyl) <- c("Two cyl", "Four cyl", "Six cyl")
qplot(mpg, wt, data = mtcars, facets = . ~ cyl)

Hadley
